exposure: preconception glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) use
cohort: Female patients aged >=18 years with a history of pregnancy, identified from the US Collaborative Network in TriNetX, including 4267 individuals with preconception GLP-1 RA use and 4267 unexposed individuals, matched for age, race, ethnicity, and comorbid conditions.
finding: Preconception glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist use was associated with a reduced risk of gestational diabetes mellitus, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, preterm delivery, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Preconception GLP-1 RA use was associated with a reduced risk of cesarean delivery.
